top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children (26 TAC §744.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was found children were leaving the classroom to use the restroom and use the water foutain unsupervised.

top_violation_types.title: Critical Injury - Contact Parent (26 TAC §744.2577(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found in non-compliance. A child received an injury in care that required medical attention. The parent was not notified until pick up.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a staff member was not relating to children with courtesy or respect as they called children names that were not kind.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care, but did not report to Child Care Licensing within two days of becoming notified.
